properties.name: Strength
properties.description: The melee attack and damage stat: the longsword and the staggering blow.

properties.name: Dexterity
properties.description: The ranged and finesse attack stat: the goblins' weapons, the crossbow and the hunter's flurry roll with it, and the hunter's flurry adds it to damage.

properties.name: Constitution
properties.description: Adds to what a rally restores to the creature it is used on.

properties.name: Maximum hit points
properties.description: A copy of the hit points' maximum, which no expression can read; bloodied reads this instead. Keep the two equal.

properties.name: Armor Class
properties.description: The defense a weapon attack rolls against, unless the power names another.

properties.name: Fortitude
properties.description: The defense the staggering blow attacks instead of Armor Class.

properties.name: Reflex
properties.description: A defense declared for later powers; nothing attacks it yet.

properties.name: Will
properties.description: A defense declared for later powers; nothing attacks it yet.

properties.name: Proficiency bonus
properties.description: What a weapon adds to the attack rolls made with it. It is the weapon's, not a creature's, and no power reads it yet: each attack still rolls the bonus it names itself.

properties.name: Damage dice
properties.description: How many damage dice a weapon rolls on a hit. It is the weapon's, not a creature's, and no power reads it yet: each attack still rolls the damage it names itself.

properties.name: Damage die
properties.description: How many sides each of a weapon's damage dice has. It is the weapon's, not a creature's, and no power reads it yet: each attack still rolls the damage it names itself.

properties.name: Range
properties.description: How many squares away a ranged weapon can strike a creature. It is the weapon's, not a creature's, and no power reads it yet: each still names its own range.

properties.name: Armor bonus
properties.description: What a suit of armor adds to its wearer's Armor Class. It is the armor's, not a creature's, and nothing adds it yet: a creature's Armor Class is still the number its statblock sets.

properties.name: Hit points
properties.description: A creature's hit points; every statblock sets their current value and maximum. At half or below the creature is bloodied, at zero it is dying, and healing clears each again.

properties.name: Flurry uses
properties.description: What the hunter's flurry, the one encounter power here, spends. Only a creature with that power needs it, one use a fresh encounter, and nothing here refills it.

forms.name: Weapon
forms.description: Something a creature attacks with: the bonus it is meant to add to the attack roll, the damage dice it rolls on a hit and, for a ranged weapon, how far it reaches.

forms.name: Armor
forms.description: Something a creature wears for protection, and the bonus it is meant to add to the wearer's Armor Class.
